name: FASTCLOSE_V13_LESSONS_FINAL

lessons.text: EXPERIMENTAL DIRECTOR LESSON 1, opening (technique only; the owner's notes above always win): open on the scene's most relevant source-supported subject, action, object or setting, cited to its ovi. Establish the place when the viewer needs it to follow the action; 01_establishing_shot is one option, not a rule. Show nothing the ovis or the PACKET do not name.

presets.use: a named object or action leads
one complete image of the subject

lessons.when_applies: the first shot of every scene.

evidence.observation: opens on the drill bit before the first wide view
evidence.provenance: owner Review 2 S01 and S03 (recorded by statement)

lessons.text: EXPERIMENTAL DIRECTOR LESSON 2, camera variation (technique only; the owner's notes above always win): choose each registered preset for the shot's action, attention and emotion. Avoid strong push-ins back to back (01_establishing_shot, 03_slow_cinematic_push, 06_blessing_gesture, 08_emotional_closeup: fixed zoom gain 0.20 or more) unless the beat gives a specific dramatic reason; repeating a preset is fine when continuity benefits.

evidence.observation: slow zooms through the setup; the one strong zoom lands on the proposal line
evidence.provenance: owner Review 1 B03, B04, B06 and B10 (owner-confirmed)

lessons.text: EXPERIMENTAL DIRECTOR LESSON 3, visible reactions (technique only; the owner's notes above always win): when an ovi describes an important character response, give it visible emphasis with a supported framing and a held pose that matches the ovi; the narrator may tell it too, but must not replace it entirely. Do not invent gestures, feelings or events the ovi does not state.
lessons.when_applies: a shot whose ovi states a person's response.

evidence.observation: one character acts, then the other responds, in order
evidence.provenance: owner Review 1 B04 and B05 (owner's words)

evidence.observation: an entrance read as a reveal

lessons.text: EXPERIMENTAL DIRECTOR LESSON 4, shot progression (technique only; the owner's notes above always win): choose framing and transitions so that events, reactions, reveals and who-is-where stay clear; use only the registered presets and the transitions cut, slide and pan_bridge. Wide-to-close is not required, and slide or pan_bridge do not need a change of place.
lessons.when_applies: the order of shots and every transition_out.

evidence.observation: transitions through black between scenes; cuts within
evidence.provenance: frozen detector STEP4_MEASUREMENTS.json plus owner visual read round 2; 4.93 s and 12.9 s OPEN

lessons.text: EXPERIMENTAL DIRECTOR LESSON 5, emotional restraint (technique only; the owner's notes above always win): in quiet or emotional moments prefer the least distracting movement whose image roles fit (09_dialogue_composition 0.13; 05_bowing_prayer, 07_character_reaction, 10_object_hand_insert 0.14), avoid unnecessary consecutive pushes, and never let a camera move suggest a story event the ovis do not state.
lessons.when_applies: visual-only shots of the timeline and ovis that state silence, stillness or devotion.

evidence.observation: the camera stays still between cuts
